title: Handling the maximum number of active EPS bearer contexts

entities.name: Maximum active EPS bearer contexts reached
entities.description: Condition where the UE has reached the maximum number of active EPS bearer contexts as defined in clause 6.5.0.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request connectivity to a PDN.

entities.name: EPS bearer context deactivation
entities.description: Procedure to deactivate an active EPS bearer context, either locally or via explicit signaling.

entities.name: Emergency EPS bearer context
entities.description: EPS bearer context established for emergency services.

entities.name: Tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed by UE to update tracking area and indicate EPS bearer context status to the network.

relations.description: When maximum active EPS bearers is reached, UE shall not send PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST unless an active bearer is deactivated.
PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST requires deactivation of an active EPS bearer context if maximum is reached.
UE shall not deactivate an EPS bearer context for emergency when requesting emergency EPS bearer context.
If UE performs local deactivation for emergency bearer, it shall perform tracking area updating procedure.
